A'maal ka tarazu: Qari'ah bhi Qayamat ka ek naam hai jaise Haqqah, Tammah, Sakhah, Ghashiyah wagairah. Is ki barai aur holnaki ke bayan ke liye sawal hota hai ke woh kya cheez hai? Is ka ilm baghair mere bataye kisi ko hasil nahin ho sakta. Phir khud batata hai ke us din log muntashir aur paraganda hairan-o-pareshan idhar udhar ghoom rahe honge jis tarah parwane hote hain aur jagah farmaya hai: "Ka'annahum jaradum muntashir" (Goya woh tiddiyan hain phaili huin). Phir farmaya paharon ka yeh haal hoga ke woh dhuni hui oon ki tarah idhar udhar urte nazar ayenge. Phir farmata hai us din har nek-o-bad ka anjam zahir ho jayega. Nekon par chha gayin bhulaiyon ka pallara halka hoga woh jahannami ho jayega, woh munh ke bal oondha jahannam mein gira diya jayega. 'Umm' se murad dimagh hai yani sar ke bal Hawiyah mein jayega aur yeh bhi ma'ni hain ke farishte jahannam mein us ke sar par azabon ki barish barsayenge aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke us ka asli thikana woh jagah jahan us ke liye qarargah muqarrar kiya gaya hai woh jahannam hai. Hawiyah jahannam ka naam hai, isi liye us ki tafsir bayan karte hue farmaya ke tumhein nahin maloom ke Hawiyah kya hai? Ab main batata hoon ke woh sholay marti bhadakti hui aag hai. Hazrat Ash'as bin Abdullah R.H farmate hain ke momin ki maut ke baad us ki rooh ko imandaron ki roohon ki taraf le jate hain aur farishte un se kehte hain ke apne bhai ki diljoi aur taskeen karo, yeh duniya ke ranj-o-gham mein mubtala tha. Ab woh nek roohein us se poochti hain ke falan ka kya haal hai? Woh kehta hai ke woh to mar chuka, tumhare paas nahin aya? To yeh samajh lete hain aur kehte hain woh to apni maa Hawiyah mein pahuncha. Ibn Marduyah ki ek marfoo hadith mein yeh bayan khoob bast se hai aur hum ne bhi ise Kitab Sifat-un-Nar mein warid kiya hai. Allah Ta'ala hamein apne fazl-o-karam se is aag jahannam se nijat de, Ameen! Phir farmata hai ke woh sakht tez hararat wali aag hai, bade sholay maarne wali, jholsa dene wali.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain tumhari yeh aag toh is ka satrahwan hissa hai. Logon ne kaha Hazrat (ﷺ) halakat ko toh yahi kaafi hai, aap ne farmaya haan lekin aatish-e-dozakh toh is se inhattar (69) hissay tez hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke har ek hissa is aag jaisa hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai. Musnad ki ek hadith mein is ke sath yeh bhi hai ke yeh aag bawajood is aag ka satrahwan hissa hone ke bhi do martaba samundar ke paani mein bujha kar bheji gayi hai, agar yeh na hota toh is se bhi nafa na utha sakte. Aur hadith mein hai yeh aag sauwan (100th) hissa hai. Tabrani mein hai jante ho ke tumhari is aag aur jahannam ki aag ke darmiyan kya nisbat hai? Tumhari is aag ke dhuen se bhi sattar (70) hissa zyada siyah khud woh aag hai. Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hadith hai ke jahannam ki aag ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh surkh hui, phir ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh safed ho gayi, phir ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh siyah ho gayi, pas ab woh sakht siyah aur bilkul andhere wali hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke sab se halkay azab wala jahannami woh hai jis ke pairon mein aag ki do jotiyan hongi jis se is ka dimagh khad-bada raha hoga. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke aag ne apne Rab se shikayat ki ke ae Allah mera ek hissa dusre ko khaye ja raha hai, toh Parwardigar ne isay do saans lene ki ijazat di, ek jaaray mein ek garmi mein. Pas sakht jaara jo tum paate ho yeh is ka sard saans hai aur sakht garmi jo padti hai yeh is ke garam saans ka asar hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke jab garmi shiddat ki paday toh namaz thandi kar ke padho, garmi ki sakhti jahannam ke josh ki wajah se hai. Alhamdulillah Surah Qari'ah ki tafsir khatam hui.

Ibn Marduyah ki ek marfoo hadith mein yeh bayan khoob bast se hai aur hum ne bhi ise Kitab Sifat-un-Nar mein warid kiya hai. Allah Ta'ala hamein apne fazl-o-karam se is aag jahannam se nijat de, Ameen! Phir farmata hai ke woh sakht tez hararat wali aag hai, bade sholay maarne wali, jholsa dene wali.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain tumhari yeh aag toh is ka satrahwan hissa hai. Logon ne kaha Hazrat (ﷺ) halakat ko toh yahi kaafi hai, aap ne farmaya haan lekin aatish-e-dozakh toh is se inhattar (69) hissay tez hai. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh hadith hai aur is mein yeh bhi hai ke har ek hissa is aag jaisa hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai. Musnad ki ek hadith mein is ke sath yeh bhi hai ke yeh aag bawajood is aag ka satrahwan hissa hone ke bhi do martaba samundar ke paani mein bujha kar bheji gayi hai, agar yeh na hota toh is se bhi nafa na utha sakte. Aur hadith mein hai yeh aag sauwan (100th) hissa hai. Tabrani mein hai jante ho ke tumhari is aag aur jahannam ki aag ke darmiyan kya nisbat hai? Tumhari is aag ke dhuen se bhi sattar (70) hissa zyada siyah khud woh aag hai. Tirmidhi aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hadith hai ke jahannam ki aag ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh surkh hui, phir ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh safed ho gayi, phir ek hazar saal tak jalayi gayi toh siyah ho gayi, pas ab woh sakht siyah aur bilkul andhere wali hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke sab se halkay azab wala jahannami woh hai jis ke pairon mein aag ki do jotiyan hongi jis se is ka dimagh khad-bada raha hoga. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke aag ne apne Rab se shikayat ki ke ae Allah mera ek hissa dusre ko khaye ja raha hai, toh Parwardigar ne isay do saans lene ki ijazat di, ek jaaray mein ek garmi mein. Pas sakht jaara jo tum paate ho yeh is ka sard saans hai aur sakht garmi jo padti hai yeh is ke garam saans ka asar hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke jab garmi shiddat ki paday toh namaz thandi kar ke padho, garmi ki sakhti jahannam ke josh ki wajah se hai. Alhamdulillah Surah Qari'ah ki tafsir khatam hui.
